tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal o rgyan pa'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs so//

na maḥshrī uḍī ya na yai/ dpal u rgyan pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i rigs ni/ u rgyan mkhan po pad+ma'i rjes bzung zhing mi bdag 'jam dbyangs khri srong lde'u btsan gyi/ 'phrin las bsrungs ma rigs 'dzin bstan skyong pa// rgyus ban byang chub gzhon nu'i gdung la ste// byang chub mchog bskrun de nyid sa bon las/ byang chub yon tan bskyed de de sras gnyis// byang chub rgya mtsho chos kyi rgya mtsho'o// mkhas pa'i mchog zung de dag rang nyid kyi// legs byas ston phyir stod du sgrod pa na// bya rog tshang gnas legs pa'i lam zhugs pa// ar tshe ban chen bcwo brgyad grags pa yis// mtho mtshams gyur la byang chub rgya mtsho'i mthus// rta mchog skur gyur rta skad "$ gsum bsgrags pas// tshar gcad rjes gzung dag pa'i lam la bkod// gang skus bsod nams byang chub yon tan ni// grags pa'i mtha' can dge ldan gsum bskyed do// bsod nams las bltam mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa// rgyus ban bde gshegs rgyu las sras bzhi'i gtso// rgyal tsha bsod nams 'phags se de'i rigs// bshes gnyen dam pa dpal ldan ge lung ba/ gdung sob khyim bdag sems dpa' jo 'phan no// de yum dru ge mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ldan mkhar// byang chubasems spros rigs kyi sras bzhi sprul// mkhas btsun mdo sde dpal gyi rgyal mtshan dang*// mtha' stag bdag nyid chen po seṅgai dpal// khab 'dzin nam mkha' dpal dang dar ma dpal// sngags 'chang dam pa'i rgyud du byung pa'o// de yang yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa dang bltam pa na 'od 'phro ba la sogs pa dge ba'i ltas dang bcas te gnas na zlum/ lo rnam 'gyur/ gza' spyi bol/ skar ma khrums/ dus nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba dang mtshungs par bltams so// lu bo chos rje go lung ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sngags don khong du chud pa/ lo i sin lugs kyi bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gzigs pa de'i zhal nas/

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i ltas yig dang bstun na/ rang don grub pa gzhan la phan pa gcig 'ong ba gsung*/ de nas ring po ma lo pa na yum gyi nu zho bsnun du byung ba der shes pa dang*/ tsog bu thub pa na/ mkha' 'gro ma pad kra ltar byung ba rnams phyis kyang dran gsung*/ cher skyes pa na brtse bas byis pa gzhan gyis srog ldan phra mo 'tshe ba las skyob/ rtsed mo thams cad bshad bsgrub kyi rnam par mdzad/ res ting nge 'dzin gcig la 'byams 'gro bas gzhan gyis glen par go /lan gcig bsha' ri ba kyi sa sgang du gzims pa'i tshe/ 'khor ba la snying po mi 'dug /thos pa cig byas la de'i don bsgom dgos bsgom dus su da lta'i sems 'di las gzhan pa'i bsgom cig yong ngam mi yong*/ yong na mi thang pa 'dra/ de tsa na da lta'i sems dang khyad par ci 'dug lta dgos snyam pa byung ste/ phyis kyang sngar gyi de ka las mi 'dug gsung*/ rtsa rlung gi yon tan 'ga' re thugs la shar nges 'byung che bas/ yab kyi khas len zhes bcos pas/ khu bo'i sar byon nas bshums pa la/ rab tu 'byung rogs bya yis ma ngu gcig gsung zhing brid dgos pa byung skad/ dgung lo bdun pa nas/ khu bo'i spyan sngar/ yab chos ma mo dang phur pa'i 'phrin las sgrub bde mchog nag po pa/ dgyes rdor mar lugs/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ yo ga gtsug dgu rnams kyi phyag len/ rgyud cha lag dang bcas pa la sbyangs/ bcu drug la be dong rin rtse can du mngon pa kun las btus la gsan sbyong mdzad/ mkhas par gyur*/ mdzod/ rnam nges/ shes rab 'grel chung sogs zhar chos su gsan/ 'dul lung sogs mdo du ma gzigs so// de nas ci zhig la yul du byon/ go lung phur/ chos rje rgod tshang pa byon pa'i zhal nas di ring 'dir las can gcig 'ong gsung*/ de nyin 'jal bas byin brlabs kyis ba spu g.yo zhing rang dbang med pa'i dad pa skye ba gcig byung*/ de rjes sbud tra bde chen gling du bzhugs pa la/

zangs gcig dang bur btang gcig phul nas/ rtsa bzhi 'chang dang lnga sdom pa'i dge bsnyen mdzad/ ka ra snyim pa phyur pa gang gnang nas/ phyis nga can du shog /thos tsam gyis grol ba gcig yong ba yin/ gal te ma byung yang phyag rgya chen po bya ba yod/ grol ba la tshegs med par bya yis gsung*/ de rten 'brel bsgrigs par 'dug /rjes la'ang*/ ban chung de sbyangs pa sngon du song ba gcig 'dug /de kun bstan pa tsam gyis grol 'gro ba yin/ lan gcig nga can du 'ong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yod pa yin gsung skad/ de nas gcen po la phar phyin gsan/ zhor la 'dul ba la lta rtog mdzad/ las brgya rtsa pa bltas tsam gyis thugs la byung gsung*/ slar yang mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan pas/ nyi shu lon pa'i tshe/ mkhan po yul mthun pa bo dong rin rtse/ las slob zhang bsam gling ba/ gsang stai ston pa slob dpon bsod nams kyis mdzad de/ dge 'dun gyi dbus su rab tu byung ba dang*/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad/ mtshan rin chen dpal du gsol/ mngon pa kun bsdus bshad/ de nas bzung ste lo bcu gnyis kyi bar sha yangs pa'i 'tsho ba stan gcig mdzad/ mkhan po la dus 'khor 'bro lugs tshar gcig gsan pa'i tshe/ khong gi zhal nas 'jig rten khams na yod pa'i chos thams cad shes par bya yis dus 'khor zhog zer yang nga mi nyan gsung zhing gsungs pas dad ste/ go lung du gcen la dus 'khor phyag lo'i bshad 'grel tshar gcig gsan/ brtsis rnams byang bar bslabs/ dgongs pa la rgyud thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig 'byed pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'di yi the tshom legs par chod pa gcig bya/ sgrod na sham bha lar yang bsgrod/ dbus gtsang gi 'di shes zer tshad la btugs la bslab dgos snyam pa byung gsung*/ gcen gyi zhal nas/ gtsang so snor mangs dgon pa na/ dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje bya ba tsam mi'i bshad bsrol skyong ba gcig yod zer bas der gzigs su byon gsung*/

zhabs tog gnyis dang bcas nas phyin/ gleng la byas pas mkhas par shes nas/ tshar gcig dri btug mdzad cing gsan pas zla ba bcu gcig 'gor/ gzhan mtshan brjod kyi sems 'grel/ dbang mdor bstan sogs khṛd phran rnams kyang gsan/ de dus nang le'i rtsa chad la sleb pa'i dus su/ gtsang so stod du ser chags kyi dbur spyan 'dren byung ba la/ spyir yang chos 'di gnyan pa gcig gda'/ khyad par dka' sgang dang gnyan par 'dug pas mi gshegs par zhus pas ma gsan/ thugs la sngon rje btsun dam pa rgya gar lta bu byon/ nga'i bla ma dus 'khor ba 'di yang dge bshes bzang po gcig 'dug ste/ rnyed pa la ltas nas rgyud gnyan po 'phro la gzhog par 'dug /nga mtshan ldan gyi bla ma gcig dang nam mjal lam snyam pa'i thug mug skyes/ spyan ras gzigs dang dam pa la gsol ba btab pas/ de nub rmi lam du/ dam pa dang mjal/ dga' ba skyes/ zhabs la bzung nas/ snying nas chos gcig bya snyam pas pha rgad po gcig kyang blos ma thongs/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma gcig dang yang ma mjal zhus pas/ skye ba 'di'i pha la zhen pa byed na skye ba sngon ma'i pha la yang byed dam gsung*/ bdag gi pha 'di gzhan dang yang mi 'dra zhus pas/ skye ba gzhan gyi pha la yang zhen pa de 'dra re yod ltos shig gsung nas/ skye ba bdun gyi gong gi yab yum bstan pas/ brtse sems da res kyi yab yum dang 'dra bar 'dug pas sems can thams cad pha mar shes nas phyogs gcig zhen pa ched song rjes su bstan pa mang po bya ste// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma gcig dang 'jal bar gda' yis gsung ngo*// de nas dgung lo nyer gsum pa'i dus yab 'das/ bsam pa la chos rje rgod tshang ba'i spyan sngar phyin la/ khong gi sgom chen tsho rkang rgod pas grogs brtsal nas sham bha lar dus 'khor gyi ma bde ba rnams 'drir 'gro bsam nas bde chen stengs su phyin/ nye gnas zhig po byang dpal byung nas/ chos rje rin po che'i sku tshe'i rten 'brel sgrig pas/

'khor snying pa tshe las gsar pa 'gyes yin yod/ slob dpon rang yang bzhugs gsung gin gda' zer ba la/ ma nyan par rnying pa su yin lo rtsis byas pas chog /nga 'gro sdod zhus pas shog gsungs pas/ mjal kha byung*/ chos rje'i zhal nas rje btsun ci la byon gsung*/ sngar gyi bsam le tshe zhus pas/ ma bde bar rang ci 'dra bde gsung rim pas zhus pas 'di yin gsung zhing 'bru gnon re mdzad/ yid ches sgro 'dogs chod/ zhal nas 'o skol skye ba mang po'i dpon slob yin/ mgon po phag mo grub pa dang grub thob gling mjal ba lta bu yin gsung*/ dgongs pa la/ gzigs rtog mang po mdzad dam/ bsgom byung gi shes rab brdol ba la 'di 'dra byung pa snyam nas/ chos rje rin po ches dus 'khor gsan snyam pa ni mi 'dra bar gda'/ bka' 'phrang rnams la ma bde ba cung zad kyang med par mkhyen pa ci lags zhus pas/ slob dpon jo btsun rgyu mtshan mang po yod/ nga rtsibs ri rgod tshang can na bsgrub pa la yod pa'i dus na/ bud med sngon mo gcig gis po ti gcig la gtad nas 'di zo zer/ de mid pas/ khyed kyis chos thams cad la mi shes pa cung zad kyang med do zer/ de dai bathams cad kyi yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin par 'dug /de phyin chad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rab 'byams la mi shes pa'i dri ma dang bral ba yin gzhan gyi blor mi tshud/ slob dpon rang la dus kyis 'khor lo'i dbang gcig dang byas pas chog gsung*/ de dus dbang ma thob yod pas thugs la gdags par zhus pas/ sang bya yis gsung*/ sngon 'gro gcig zhu zhus pas/ bla ma sangs rgyas su bsgoms la gsol ba thob gsung*/ sangs rgyas sam de gser mdog can de yin pa la/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa la sangs rgyas su bsgoms pas ci la phan nam snyam pa mkhyen nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas su gsal gyin 'dug ge bya/ ci yang zhu ma nus pas/ rang lus spyan ras gzigs su gsal yer bsgoms/

snying gi dbus su bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu bsgoms la gsol ba thob gcig gsung*/ sgoms pas rang 'phags par gsal yer byung bas/ rang spyan ras gzigs su bsgom btub par gda' bas/ bla ma sangs rgyas su bsgom par zhu byas pas/ phyag g.yas pa brkyang nas khyod las nga mi zhan pa yin no yang yang gsung*/ de phyin chad bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes pa yin gsung*/ phyis yang zhus pas de bzhin du bya gsung nas gser zho de gnang ste nyid rang 'dun pa thong gcig gsung*/ gsol ba 'debs cing 'dun pa btang bas/ tshes bcu gcig gi nus mo bla ma dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje byon nas dkyil 'khor sa bzung ba mdzad de nyin par sta gon thun mong gi dbang bdun gong ma gsum/ bcu gcig pa 'jig rten las 'das pa/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mthar thug pa bskur te/ po ti/ dung*/ rnga bzang po rnams gtad nas rjes gnang mdzad pa las sad pas/ shin tu dgyes te byon pas/ chos rje sku gzi mdangs cher bskyed spyan dmar shig ge bzhugs nas/ slob dpon jo btsun bsam pa rdzogs par byung ngam gsung*/ 'di lta bu mchis pa ngo mtshar che zhus pas/ nga la yang rgyal ba'i yum rnal 'byor mas po ti byin nas lung bstan/ ngas kyang khyed la dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur po ti byin pas khyod kyi bka' rab 'byam la mi shes pa mi 'ong gsung*/ phyag rgya chen po'i khrid zhus pas/ khyed la khrid du bya mi dgos ngo sprad pas chog par 'dug gsung nas gc-ig char ngo sprad/ zhag bzhi na dmar 'od gsal 'khor yug du song*/ dngas cha la dngos po thams cad la chags thogs med par mi dang m-i ma yin thams cad mthong ba dang*/ sgom chen pho mo tsho'i grib gzugs na bun lta bu/ che chung dang yod med rnams mthong ba dang*/ rnal 'od gsal du yod pa'i tshe rin chen snying po gsal 'dren du byung ba mthong bas spyi po'i gam sleb pa la sad ran snyam du byas pas sad pa la sogs byung gsung*/

thabs lam zhus pas/ khyed la las 'phro yod pa yin gsung nas gnang ste sgoms pas/ rtsol ba chung ngus bde drod ngo 'phrod pa legs nyams myong dang drod rtags rnams byung lugs zhus pas/ skye tshul phun sum tshogs pa byung 'dug /ngas las 'phro yod byas pa gsung*/ nub gcig lus ro ru song 'dug pa gcig rmis/ ci rmis tshur bya ba la zhus pas/ mi ro lta bu'i bsam gtan bya ba phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa rkyen gang gis kyang mi g.yo ba gcig la 'ong ba yin gsung*/ bsgoms pas 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du rtogs/ sa ra ha la yang 'di las lhag pa'i rtogs pa yod de mi yong snyam pa byung gsung*/ yang rje btsun ras chung pa ras dmar po gsol ba gcig byon nas lus gnad gcig bstan pas bde drod du phril song ba gcig rmis/ kun dha ba g.ye med du gyur pa la sogs 'ga' gnang nas zhus pas/ khyed kyi skye ba mang po'i yi dam bde mchog lhan skyes yin gsung*/ rin po che pa 'di'i sprul pa 'di gsungs pa la the tshom skyes zhus pas/ de la log lta skye ru med gsung*/ 'o na rje rin po che pa nyid mi la'i sprul pa yin skad pa de lags sam zhus pas/ thugs hur mdzad de/ de la 'gal pa med/ rang gi rgyud pa rang gis 'dzin dgos pa yin/ bu rang yang smin smin pa gcig yin yang yang gsung ba bdag gang ltar yin zhus na yong bar 'dug ste/ byin brlabs kyis shes pa za zir song nas ci yang zhu sa ma byung gsung*/ yang rin po che/ rta dang*/ glang po dang*/ seng ge la lcibs nas nam mkha' la 'byon bzhud byed pa'i rmi lam 'byung ba zhus pas/ sa thob pa yin pa la mi yong ba yin gsung*/ rgyun prang gcig na 'dug pa bkag la/ tha ba rlog pa/ chu prol la zam pa 'dzugs pa byung lags zhus pas/ rmi lam bzang*/ rigs drug gi rgyun bsrang bcad/ nyon mongs pa'i tha ba thul/ 'khor ba'i chu bo rgal bya ba yin gsung yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin brlabs gcig zhu bzhed tsam na 'od gsal gyi ngang du byon nas mdzad/

gzhan yang sgyu lus 'od gsal gyi ngang nas nyi zla la zhon te gling bzhi lta ba la sogs byas pa rnams zhus pas shin tu mnyes te/ sku mtshams kyi dus su'ang sgom med du zab khrid thams cad rdzogs par snang*/ rmi lam du lung pa ri dgas kyis gang ba gsum 'dug pa'i gnyis/ chos rje 'brug pa dang*/ rgod tshang pas bsgral ba yin gcig khyod kyis bsgrol rgyu yin zer ba gcig rmis/ rin po ches rgyud 'dzin du lung bstan/ rje btsun ras chung pa tshogs 'di na bzhugs kyang bya/ mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mos gzigs nas/ nyid las bsags pa gru bzhi gcig 'dug zer ste/ sgog pa spar gang gtad nas 'di gsol zer/ ma bzhed/ chos rje la zhus pas/ a pa de len pa lags pa la/ longs spyod kyi rten 'brel bag tsam dang 'chugs/ rje 'bri khung pa tsam 'ong pa la gsung yang*/ chos nyag gcig gi bsags pa nga che ba yin phyaugs mtha' dag gi bsags pa khyed che ba yin gsung*/ thugs bskyed zhus/ bdag gzhan rje phod pa'i brtse ba dang*/ byang chub sems 'khrungs/ nyin gcig 'chag go dang 'bu shigs pa gcig mthong ba la skyug log byung bas/ der dbu bcug nas gnad du bsnun te bsgoms pas/ snang ba thams cad rang gi sems las don logs na med par thag chod/ mi gtsang ba'i do skyug bro bar mi 'dug rang gi sems skyug bro bar 'dug /de bzhin du sa log pa sra ba legs par mig 'dug /rang gi sems sra zhing 'thas par/ brlan zhing gsher bar/ tsha zhing sreg par/ yang zhing g.yo bar 'dug /sems kyi rang bzhin stong par 'dug /sems can spyi mthun gyi sems sra zhing 'thas pa la sogs par snang bas phyi rol du ba la sogs par snang zhing*/ stong pa las nam mkha'i khams su snang bar thag chod pa yin gsung*/ der snang ba thams cad/ rang gi sems su song*/ stong pa tha mal gyi shes pa rang gar khres song nas/ dran pas bzung rgyu dang*/ 'dzin byed dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang gnyen po gang yang med par/

snang ba thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma ltar za zi ban bun du song 'dug /thugs la 'khor yug ma yin dgongs pa byung nyin gcig 'gro ba bzang mo na re/ khyod kyi bsgom de 'khor yug ma rang yang cung min gsung*/ rgyu mtshan ci yin byas pas/ de la ngo shes gcig yod na yin gsung*/ 'dre mo 'di ci zer dgongs nas zhur byon pas/ zhal nas da lta nas re bas ga na 'ong*/ phyis 'ong ba yin mod gsung*/ bu khyod 'gro don byed pa gcig 'byung ba yin/ lo gcig gnyis kyi bar du 'gro don ma byed/ de nas mnyam rjes med pa'i rtogs pa 'char/ de yan chad ci dga' gyis khyod kyis gang byas kyang lam du 'gro ba gcig 'ong ba yin/ nga'i 'di/ zhi ba'i phrin las 'ba' zhig yin/ khyod 'phrin las thams cad kyi mnga' bdag du 'gyur gsung*/ yang khyod la glengs mang po yong gsung*/ nad chen bzhi la sogs pa mchi'am zhus pas/ de rnams mi yong*/ nye ba dgrar sdang*/ dgra mang po yong ba de lam du slong dgos gsung*/ nyin gcig 'gro bzang ma tshogs 'khor byed zer ba la/ shangs par ring mo'i bsags pa'i snang tshul lam/ che chos 'dra ba bzhag nas sgo ma gcig la tshogs 'dren pa dgongs pas/ de ma thag 'gro bzang ma khams log /nga'i snying ri brtser song*/ rje btsun snod ma rung la tshogs bshad pas lan gsung*/ 'gro bzang ma'i sras mo gnyis byung nas/ slob dpon a ma la gshags pa mdzad par zhu zer/ chos rje la gshags pa mdzad pas/ 'gro bzang ma rang la gyis gsung*/ mdzad du byon pas/ me 'dar sprug cing 'dug pa bzhin/ bde chen stengs kyi ri dang nags tshal thams cad tshig chil chil khol du g.yo zhing 'dug /spyi bshags gsum mdzad pas/ nga'i snying tshud snying tshud zer zhing lhod song*/ mkha' 'gro'i snying dam tshig du yod par 'dug gsung*/ de tsam na sgo ma rnams dge 'dun pa dang bsres shing chos nyan pa yod pa/ mi mdzes pa dang*/ reg pa'i ltung bas gos par mthong ste/

sa mtshams phye/ de las 'das pa'i sgo ma rnams brdungs pas/ nang par rin po che khri thog du byon pa'i sku skeg nas/ rdo rje dar sna lngas spras pa gcig btang rag yin gsung nas gnang ba la sogs rten 'brel mang po bsgrigs/ de dus chos rje la lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa thams cad ltos med du phul nas tshe rabs thams cad du 'phrin las kyi lag len pa byed par zhus pa yin gsung*/ gzims khang la/ kha ba'i rud byung ba la lta stangs dang sdig 'dzub gtad pas 'khyil/ nyin gcig tshogs kyi dbus su chos rje'i zhal nas/ de ring slob dpon rje btsun gyis gang zhus pa gnang ba yin gsung*/ phyag byas nas rin po che dgung lo brgya'i bar bzhugs par zhu zhus pas/ phyag nam mkhar brkyang nas de bzhin byed pa yin/ slob dpon rang nga'i gan nas ma 'phags pa gcig ni dgos so bya/ yang lan gcig slob dpon nga'i gzims khang gi blo 'bur gcig du bzhugs/ stan re tsam sprug pa dang*/ mchod pa dang maṇ+ḍa la re brje ba tsam mdzod/ chos tsho nyon/ khyed nye gnas kyi rgyu ru 'phangs pa yin kyang*/ khrid gnyer mdzod/ dpe 'di pa'i bdag yong ba khyed las med thun mong du bya/ gang du yang ma 'gro/ khyed rang gi rten 'brel thams cad kyang 'grig /nga'i tshe la yang phan gsung*/ de shin du thugs la btags te gzhan gyis phra dog mchi zhus pas ma dgongs pa la/ slob dpon legs mdzes la sogs pas ma bzod nas mi 'jog par zhus pas/ tshogs 'di na khong bsags pa che bar 'dug /rang rgyud pa gcig mi gda'/ nga rang gang byed pa byed du chugs su/ yang slob dpon rang la nye gnas mi mdzad par zhus pas/ nga la chos rje'i gsung nges par byon nas byas pa yin/ lto ma phyid nas sdod pa min/ tshe 'di'i phyogs nas nye gnas thob sha mi dgos/ mtshan nyid kyi bshad pa byas kyang kā pa li 'grems pas brgya re mi 'tshog gam/ khyed rnams dga' nas ngas bzhag pas chog gsung nas bzhugs pas kun gyis jo bo bzang zer ba byung*/

de'i dus na yang na bza' phya ru/ zas bstan gcig mdza' dmar mig skyur mig mi mdzad de btsun par grags pa yin skad/ skyo bar byung nas sham bha lar 'gro bar zhus pas ma gnang*/ skyar yin zhus pas/ tshems nan pa gcig mdzad nas rgyug dang gsung bas/ tab tob la da sdod par zhu zhus gda'/ de thugs bdud kyis sgyur bar 'dug gsung*/ yang khyed tshogs 'dir yod pa tsam gyis nga yi tshe la phan pa yin gsung yang*/ mched grogs kyis log sgrub kyis skyo nas/ zhing dag par smon lam btab nas 'pho bar gzhed pa'i sbyor ba la zhugs pa/ ḍā ki ma 'gro bzang mas rig nas/ chos rje la sbran pas shog gsung nas/ bu de skad ma byed cig /byang chub sems dpa' rnams zhing gang ma dag pa/ gdug rtsub che ba rnams su skye ba len pa yin/ zhing dag pa dang chos theg chen 'ba' zhig ston pa'i 'dod pa rnams byang chub sems dpa'i skyon yin gsung bas/ 'dun pa de khugs kyang*/ byang dar 'og gi mtsho de la 'gro bzhed pa yang yang zhus kyang ma gnang ba der 'gro ba'i 'dun pa ma khugs par 'gro bar zhus pas/ 'u rang pha phad jo bo bzang bar grags pas kyang lan/ 'di pa nga tsho ring bas ci zhig ste/ mos gus kyi snang tshul lam sangs rgyas pa'am de nga rang min pa mi 'dug gis gsung*/ thugs ma zhum par phyag brkyang nas bdag bde go zhus pas/ zhal 'dzum la rten 'brel bzang bar song gsung*/ yang 'gro ba'i zhal bskos zhus pas/ ri khrod la phyin yang bu rang gi rten 'brel legs po yong bar gda'/ mdang mi gnyis chu phar skar shing thog len 'gro yin 'dug pa'i gcig chus khyer/ gcig gis 'bras bu smin pa lon byung*/ bus dngos grub thob nas 'ong bar 'dug gis bzhud/ bsgrub pa yang mthar skyol 'ong*/ lo sum cu rtsa lnga'i bar 'gro don ma byed/ de nas brtsol med du 'ong ba yin gsung*/ de nas dpon srin po gdong dang*/ spa tshab gnyis dang lhan gcig do la byon/

gsum ka la rgyags bre lnga lnga las med/ chu dang rde'u'i dka' thub mdzad/ res 'ga' sha rus gro ma brkos pa dang*/ nya'i thod dang ko mo'i sha bal btsos kyin gsol/ nas tshum gcig yod pa btsos yin tshogs 'khor kyang mdzad/ nyin gcig bsags pa spang du btsugs nas gro ma thur byon pas khong gis phad bu gang dang*/ nya sha 'ga' rnyed/ dpon srin po gdong gis snyim pa gang las/ gzhan des ci yang ma rnyed/ byang ma bsgrod par chag gi ru ba'i khrod la song ngo*/ byang mi med kyi thang la zla dgu phyin// 'tsho ba chus rde'u gnyis la byas// nya sha khron gsum rus khu zos// pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse yin// gsung*/ de dus thugs dam 'phel ba/ rig pa dngas pa/ ri dgas kyi grib kyang tshor ba byung*/ nub gcig mar thud kyi dri ma byung nas nang par smras pas/ dpon srin po sdong na re/ dmar bar gda' ste byang kha stong pa'i 'di ru byung dogs med zer/ de nas dgongs zhing je cher song tsam na/ nyin cig thag rings su sbra 'ga' thor byung*/ nang par bsod snyoms la byon pas/ byis pa lug dum ded pa gcig dang phrad pa la su yin dris pas/ be ri yin/ 'babs sa ma btsal na gnod pa byed zer/ phyin pas khyi rdzi chos skyabs bya ba dang phrad pa la babs/ mgo 'tsho min/ ri ya gi la sdod pa'i sgom chen yin/ 'tsho ba chu rde'u las med pas slong du 'ongs pa yin byas pas/ bltar song zer nas bltas pas/ rtsa mal thab sbud pa rdza ma la chu skol ba'i rjes min pa med pa rnams mthong nas dad de/ mar thud dang sha skam mang du phul/ khong gis dal res kyis gsol bas ring po ma thub pa la/ dpon srin pos phul bas/ kha ning mnyam du yod pa yin/ da khyed kyi skal ba nga mi za gsung nas ma bzhed/ yang sbra pa gsar pa 'ga' byung ba la slong du phyin pas/ khyi thu mo 'dug bu mo gcig la khog byas pas ma nyan/ der rgod rkang la glong mo brtags pa bskor 'phro bcad nas/

rang*/ khyi/ bu mo'i sems gsum bsres nas bzhugs pas/ bdag po 'dris pa la byed par ltar ldag cing 'dug dad nas 'bul pa byas/ bsnyen gnas/ spyan ras gzigs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor pa la sogs pa bshad/ de tsam na/ phug gnyan gcig na sgom chen gcig shi ba'i dug po la zil chen po 'dug nyams snang la g.yag gcig gas brdung du byung*/ bud med gcig gis 'dis nga la yang brdungs khyod 'dir ma sdod zer/ nang par nya ro gcig la tshogs mdzad nas phur pa'i skul gcig byas pas brag zhig gzhi bdag de don song gsung*/ de nas byang kha na mar byon pas res chu yang ma rnyed/ kha ba chen po bab pas spyan phyid/ nas sbar gang yod pa lhung bzed du btsos nas drangs/ dol po nas lam byung nas ti ser byon/ shel gyi mchod rten nang gzhal yas khang du yod pa gcig du gzigs/ de'i 'od kyis khyab tshad rig pa dngas par 'dug gsung*/ rgya ras pa ma sdod zer nas phud du byung pa la/ sku ra rin po che dang*/ cung legs par sgom kyang ma thub ti se rang du sgoms pas 'don du ma byung gsung*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas bshad pa'i phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rten 'brel pa rnams rang gi mtshan nyid du thugs la 'khrungs nas/ phyi nang gsal byed mdzad/ de dus bzang rtog re byung rde'u dkar po re/ ngan rtog re byung nag po re bzhag /bzhug dkar po shas cher song nas bzhad yal yal mdzad/ ma pham mtsho 'gram du chu'i dka' thub mdzad/ pu hrangs stong dmar nas ti se byang sgor nyi ma phyed kad res phebs pa dang*/ sku mi snang bar bsgoms nas byon pas gzhan gyis mi mthong ba byung*/ phal pa'i nyin lam bdun bdun nyi ma re la bcad kyang nyams 'bar bas ngal ba tsam ma byung*/ ku lu ta dang ma rur byon/ de nas zhing skyong bud med sna nas mar khu 'dzag pa gcig 'dug pa yis/ khyod dang po bla ma'i zhabs su mi sdod/ de nas grogs kyi zla la mi sdod da 'di nas gar yang ma 'gro 'tsho ba sbyar ro zer/

u rgyan du gshegs pa'i thugs 'dun btang bas/ mtshan mo nam mkha' la rigs 'dzin ḍā ki byon nas rdo rje'i glu gsungs/ dbyar ghan dha la ru bsam gtan mdzad/ ngan rtog gi rde'u nag po rgyun chad gsung*/ dgun rgya ras pa 'ga' dang sdongs nas dzā lan dha raḥru byon/ shri na ga kro ta zhes bya ba'i grong khyer chen por sleb/ 'tsho ba bsod snyoms dang dka' thub mdzad nas klu sgrub phug bya ba 'dug par bzhugs/ de na rnal 'byor ma grub pa thob pa gcig 'dug pa dang chos kyi gleng langs byas/ der srod gcig gtad med du song nas/ grong khyer de la mi thogs bar song 'dug /shes pa ban bun lus zag med du song 'dug /grong khyer de thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i pho brang du 'dug gsung*/ de na chu klung chos 'byung lta bu gnyan pa gcig snang*/ dur khrod la gu raḥbya ba na/ pha 'ong thod pa lta bu la rje btsun ma'i sku rang byon du byon pa yod/ der grogs po tshos tshogs byas ba'i gral du tshud/ de dus thugs skyo ba dang*/ gnas kyi slongs kyis snang ba thams cad za zir song*/ u rgyan du gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs drag po byung*/ rten de la mchod pa gcig phul nas gsol ba btab cing rten 'brel sgrigs pas/ rengs pa dang rmugs pa la sogs pa'i bar chad mang du byung*/ grogs rnams kyis bltas rtsub pas mi gshegs par zhus kyang thugs ma khugs ste/ dpon srin po sdong dang*/ dpal ye gnyis dang gsum gyis tshogs gcig mdzad/ 'o skol gsum 'tshogs nas tshogs byed pa da res tsam yin no gsung*/ lhag gtor ma btang bar gzims pas/ 'byung po rnams skal ba chad pa'i ku co 'don pa la/ 'ur su che lta'o gsung nas gzims pas/ slar la ca co cher song nas gzims su ma ster bas 'bras tshems gcig byin kyang ma phan/ btsos nas de na 'dug go zhes byin pas med par song gsung*/ nang par dpon srin po gdong*/

yang u rgyan du 'gro gsung ba la/ mi khrid gsungs pas/ nga ngu gsung*/ rten 'brel mi btub glu gyis gsungs nas dbyug pas sa la brdabs pas/ chog zer nas/ byin brlabs zhus phyag thon/ a lo la zer zhing log bzhud/ de nas grogs dbal ye dang bsdongs nas u rgyan du byon/ grogs gnyis kyis tshogs chas kyis gsung nas gser re phul/ mgul du btags nas phyin pas blo mi bde khyog ge 'dug cis lan gzigs pas des lan par go /rgyang du 'phangs nas bde cham song*/ phangs pa mi 'dug pas blangs nas dbyug pa'i rtse la btags nas mi dang phrad pa'i tshai gser 'di na byas pas/ khyod kyi de ru gser 'ong zer zhing*/ mig kyang mi lta bar 'dug chom rkun pas 'jigs nas mtshan mo phyin pas thugs 'tshub par byung*/ bar chad 'ong bar 'dug zer zhing phyin pas g.yang la lhung nas tshems thams cad chag zug dpag tu med pa byung*/ der zhing skyong gi ḍā ki 'ga' byon nas/ chu ser 'don pa dang dngas ma bsdud pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnang nas sos de dpon srin po bsdong yul gnyan po de la tshig rtsub smras pa des lan 'dug gsung*/ gzhan yang lam gyi mi ma yin gyi bar chad rnams ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis gnan nas gsol ba 'debs kyin byon/ nam mkhar mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pa gzigs/ sku'i gzi mdangs 'bar/ spyan gyi lta stangs stod nas/ da ni tshe 'di blos gtong*/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtsal sbyong*/ bde sdug gi snang ba ro snyoms byed/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ci grub byed gsung nas byon pas nyi ma gcig la zla phyed kyi lam chod pa byung gsung*/ dpal ye la bud med nam mkha'i mdog can nam mkhar 'gro ba mang po'i nang nas gnyis kyis lag pa nas khrid pa'i snang ba byung*/ snang ba gtad med la song tsam na lam thug med gcig chod/ rkang 'gyegs thob pa'i grags pa byung gsung*/ lam du slong du phyin pa'i sar mu stegs byed/

dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su ra rog bzhi mchod pa byed pa gcig du tshud nas bsod par sgros pa la rten 'brel mdzad pas zlogs/ sog po shi skyid dang phrad pa la skud pa gcig la mdud pa bdun mdzad pa'i sna mo gnyis nas then pas kha khyed che lus/ de nas kha che'i chu bzhug tsan dan bha ga'i 'gram/ in+t+ra ni zhes pa'i grong*/ shar phyogs na rgya skags kyi tshal yod par sleb/ nub gcig bud med gcig gis mtshon mang po sgre bar bcug 'jog pa rmis/ nang par sog po rta pa bzhi byung nas brdungs/ thugs ngar bskyed nas brtul shugs btsongs pas/ sgom thag gis mgur bsgags nas phyed skad cig khrid/ brang rtog pas brdungs/ de dus snang ba dmar thing la ci yang mi mthong bar song*/ rlung sems a thung la bsdus pas/ dbus mar tshud nas mi rtog par song*/ dpal ye na re/ khyed mig sngo lding nge byas shi 'dug snyam zer/ de nas thugs 'ur gsung mang po byon/ lta stangs kyis gzir cing zil gyis mnan pas/ sog po de kha zhom song nas 'dar lhod lhod 'dug gsung*/ mdor na/ yar mar gyi lam du brdung brtag bdun bcu rtsa gcig myong*/ khyad par bud med kyis brdungs pa mang gsung de nas zhag lnga na na hu gri'i tsha gar sleb/ de nas zhag gcig phyin pa na bha tro la dang*/ de nas nyin gcig gis ma la ko trer sleb mu stegs 'byung ba'i sgo yin/ rtsi po che mang po skye/ de nas de bu dzhi ta bhir zer ba la blangs na kha zas dang gos ster bar 'dug /de na rgyal bu hu la hu gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing 'dug /de nas nub byang du zhag lnga song ba na dhu ka la bya ba snang de nas zhag bzhis rā dzā hur du sleb ste u rgyan du 'jug pa la/ ni li pa/ pur shwa ra/ ka heka bya ba dang sgo bzhi yod pa'i gcig yin no// grong khyer der bsod snyoms mdzad pa'i 'bras chen grog ma dang 'bu gzhan du song nas gsol du ma btub/

de'i nub phyogs na chu bo sin+hu 'bab pa'i rtsar sleb du nye ba'i sar mnyel mdzad de gzims bzhugs pas/ dpal ye na re slob dpon rje btsun bzhengs dang*/ nam mkha'i nas chu ya gi tsam byung zer/ bltas pas gtsang po nam mkha' la 'gro yin snang*/ gnam sa bla log 'gyur te/ sog po'i rta pa kun yang spyi tshugs su glu len cing 'gro bar mthong*/ mig yang mi gsal/ gom pa yang 'khyer nas gcig la gcig rten cing rā dzā hur du log phyin/ gzhan gyis btsongs dogs pas grong mtha'i phag tshang gcig du bzhugs/ dpal ye la g.yas su rta pa mang po rgyug g.yon nas mar bud med mang po shon brtse ba'i snang ba byung ba la/ ro rkyang gnyis su rlung shor ba'i snang ba yin gsung nas lus gnad gcig bcos pas phan/ gzhan yang mthong snang dpag tu med pa byung*/ de dus gnyis ka'i zhal nas rnag khrag 'dres pa snyim re tsam skyugs te rtsa nang gi nad dag par 'dug gsung*/ nang par bsod snyoms kyang ma nus te gcig la gcig mjus nas gru gar byon/ gnyan pa la sgrol byas pas/ phar gar khyod hor du 'dug zer nas bsod zer/ mi 'jigs kyis sgrol byas pas bsgral/ phar khar sleb tsam gyis bde'o// de phan chad u rgyan gyi sa cha yin te/ grong khyer khri phrag dgu yod par grags/ 'on kyang de rang na dhu ma tha la ma gtogs pa la u rgyan m-i zer gsung*/ de dus yul de hor gyis bcom ma thog tu 'dug pas/ chu bo de dang nye ba'i grong khyer ka la pur bya bar srod 'gros byas nas phyin pas/ stag gzigs gi nyul ma byung zer nas rdo char phab/ shing sdong gi phag tu bros nas yib pas nang du log song*/ char chen po yang bab/ khyis yang mi tshor bar 'dug pas brang kha na yar bros phyin/ nang par lam du/ stag gzig la bros pa'i gza' mi gsum ba glang sogs ded pa gcig dang phrad/ de sa la bed kyi dz+yo ki u rgyan skor du 'gro ba yin kyis ka heka sin+hu ra 'byung ba'i gnas dang*/

de nas gsum gyi kha rag du khyed la 'babs so byas pas/ dhu ma tha la'i grong khyer mchog gi bar du thub kyi zer nas khas blangs so// de nas nyi ma gnyis kyis/ ka hoka sin+hu ra 'byung ba'i gnas dang*/ de nas gsum gyis kha rag khar du sleb grong khyer de'i shar na i lo par pa ta zhes bya ba'i grub pa'i ri bo yod de/ de las grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa mang du bzhugs/ khyad par du skal ba dang ldan pa rjes su 'dzin pa sprul pa sna tshogs mdzad pa cig yod zer/ ri de gzhal yas khang du yod pa'i nang na/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bzhugs pa la/ ye shes kyi ḍā ki dpag tu med pa 'dus nas tshogs dang mchod pa mdzad cing 'dug de'i sgor rnal 'byor pa dmar po nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu gcig yod pa gcig gis bsrung zhing 'dug /gsang bdag gi ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan la nang gi gsang sngags kyi gter blta dgos pas zil gyis ma non gsung*/ de nas nyi ma phyed gnyis kyis ra hi khar sleb/ de rgyal po in+t+ra bo dhi'i khab kyi shol yin zer/ so phag gi phung po 'dug pa gzigs tsam na nga'i yin snyam pa dang*/ gzhan gyis brnyas pa byed du byung ba la'ang sa cha 'di pa nga yi yin te snyam pa byung*/ de'i byang phyogs maṃ gha la hor bya ba'i gtsug lag khang yod pa yin zer ba rgyang nas mthong*/ ra hika'i rtsa na chu bran lhor 'bab pa gcig rgal ba'i brag sna gcig la/ slob dpon lā ba pa'i dgon pa yod/ de'i steng na ḍā ki mas rdo'i ser ba phab pa la/ hūm̐ zhes sdig 'dzub gtad pas rengs nas nam mkhar chags pa yin zer ba sbra tsam gcig 'dug yul de kun gyi bud med de rnams kyis stag gzig dang lce spyang la sogs par sprul shes shing 'dug tha mal gyi rtog pa khems pa re byung tsa na/ phra men sha za'i mkha' 'gro rnams rong sleb nas za ba yin zer bar snang*/ gsang bdag gi ting nge 'dzin gsal btab nas khyed dngos za'am byas tsa na mig zhel 'gro yin gda'/

bud med gcig gis khyod in+t+ra bo dhi yin zer ba byung gsung*/ yul de nas nyi ma phyed kyis/ gnas dngos dhu ma tha lar sleb/ mi khyim lnga brgya tsam 'dug grong khyer de gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs rtsis med du song*/ de na gnas pa'i mi thams cad tha mal pa dang mi 'dra bar rigs lnga'i kha dog du snang ba/ bud med thams cad kyis sprul sgyur shes pa/ brda dang brda'i lan 'debs pa/ nus pa thogs med du ston pa/ 'dod yon la mig ser dag pa 'dug thog mar phebs pa'i nub mo/ shar phyogs na ma ga la rdo wi ces pa'i lha khang chung ngu na/ tsan+dan las rang byon gyi rje btsun ma bzhugs pa 'dug pa'i drung du nyal/ grong khyer gyi bud med rnal 'byor ma dngos/ de shes dka' bas thams cad la blangs nang gcig gis dngos sgrub ster zer ba thos nas/ nang par/ prang kha gsum 'dug pa'i byang phyogs la dpal ye/ lho phyogs la khong gi slong du byon pas/ rnal 'byor ma du mas mdun bsus nas me tog gtor/ sin+hu ra'i trik+ka 'debs/ lus ngag gi brda ston cing bsnyen bkur bar mdzad/ grogs po la de las zlog par byas 'dug pa skyabs dgos pa byung skad/ yang nyin cig 'tsho ba blang nas a na dha ko ces pa'i phyogs kyi sgang gcig la sdad pa'i tshe na chung ma spyan gsum yod pa dang*/ dpral bar rang 'byung gi mtshal gyi dga' ba 'khyil pa'i sha mtshan yod pa dang phrad/ su yin dris pas rang byung gi rnal 'byor ma'o zer/ bla ma dang chos la sogs pa dris pas kyang nga rang ngo zer/ sog po tshong pa gcig gis khyod rnal 'byor ma yin na nga'i yul nas spyad pa gcig long dang zer bas/ skad gcig de la gtor zhwa/ mda' gzhu gsum gtad pas dad 'dug de rnal 'byor mar shes nas blangs pas zas sna mang po sbyar nas byin/ zos pas ting nge 'dzin du cham song nas/ thugs dam dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa la bogs chen po thon/ chos zhus pas khyed 'dod pa kā ka mar 'byung ngo zer ro// bud med de pha rgyal po'i btsun mor 'dug gsung ngo*// grong khyer gyi phyogs bzhi na so ni/

na ku ri/ ma tam ge /ta pa si ni/ zhes pa'i dz+yo ki chen po bzhi 'dug pa la ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa yul nas gsol ba btab pas ltas mang po byung ngo*// de nas ka ka la'i grong du blangs pas/ sa mun+t+ra pu kha zer ba'i smad 'tshong ma cig gis tshod ma phor gang byin pa la brten nas/ skad gcig ma la/ sa g.yos/ lus kyi gnyer kha mi 'ong*/ snang ba yam yom shes pa chad chod du song*/ grogs skad cig la lus mi 'dra ba bcu drug blangs pa la sogs gnas sbyong dpag tu med pa byung*/ dmyal ba yi dwags kyi sa bon ni mi 'dug lha mi dud 'gro'i shas che bar 'dug pug ron du gyur pa la khras bshur bas 'jigs skrag drag po byung*/ shes pa za ya ru song*/ rig pa ngos bzung du mi btub pa de bas thu ba ma byung gsung*/ gzhan yang snang ba la 'di ma byung bya ba med/ kun bzhi la bag chags yod tshad 'char dgos par 'dug /mi 'char ba sus kyang mi thub par 'dug shar tshad sgom du shes dgos par 'dug /sgom du shar ba de med na smyon pa'am gegs yong ba la tshegs mi 'dug gsung*/ de'i rjes la rig pa gsal zhing dngas pa/ ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba/ snang ba 'di la kyag gtad spu tsam gcig kyang med par song*/ phyi rol gyi yul snang dang*/ nang gi rtsa rlung thams cad shes pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs su krong song*/ rang gi lus sprug pa ltar snod kyi 'byung bas kyang tshugs mi thub par 'phar zhing 'phrig /g.yo zhing ldog phyogs thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med par shig shig 'dug nang lus kyi rtsa rlung gi gnas tshul skyon yon skyed mi skyed/ 'di las 'di 'gyur gyi gsang chen gyi rten 'brel gyi gnad rnams gzigs ste/ de dus sa thob pa'i yon tan bshad tshod cha mthun skyes 'dug gsung*/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ rnam smin gyi lus la bag chags la brten pa'i rtsa grub/ der rlung rgyus/ rlung gis drangs nas byang chub kyi sems dbu mar song bas bag chags kyi rnam rtog skad cig ma shar ba de'i bden 'dzin zhig pas rlung zhi/

dngas ma rang gnas su brtan/ rtsa mdud zhig pa las yin te/ nang du dus rtsa lnga sreg gzugs gzigs/ 'dzag med dang po thob/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi gnad thams cad dus gcig la shar nas ma bde ba'i sgro 'dogs chod/ de dus bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor ma sin+hu ra'i mdog ltar dngas ba/ gzi brjid nyi ma'i snying po bas lhag pa dang mjal/ rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen bsgrub bdud rtsi lta bu snang*/ gsang sngags bla na med pa'i dgongs pa ma lus par thugs su chud de/ da nga'i lus 'di zag pa med pa rdo rje'i lus su song 'dug gsung*/ phyag 'tshal de thugs la dpal ye la'ang dngos grub kyi rdzas de zhus la sbyin du gzhug snyam nas sbran kyang gzhan gyis gegs byas pas dngos grub kyi rdzas ma thob/ rigs drug gi gnas sbyong byung*/ yid dam dang dpa' bo ḍā ki du ma'i zhal gzigs/ 'dod pa rtsa ba nas zad pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig yin gsung*/ de nas dhu ma thā la'i nub na/ ka ma dha ko'i gangs rnal 'byor ma'i phreng yin zer ba nas/ ko tam bha ra'i chu de 'bab/ de la 'thungs pas ting nge 'dzin skye skad/ gangs de'i nang na grub pa'i gnas ka ma ka dha gu pa'i nang na khro bo mthing nag rgyan drug gis btab pa/ gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar mi bzod par 'bar ba/ zil che ba gcig 'dug ste dpal bde mchog rang yin pa 'dra gsung*/ grong khyer de'i shar na ka bir sma sha na bya ba dur khrod brgyad kyi ya ba gcig yin zer ba 'jigs su rung zhing skyi bung byed pa yod/ de'i byang na shing brgyad kyi ya ba yin zer ba a shwa bh+ri k+ṣa bya ba dang*/ de'i drung na ka pa la bho bh+yon bya ba'i rdo la tshangs pa/ khyab 'jug /dbang phyug /rang byung du yod pa dang*/ lho na dhu mu khu ces pa zhing skyong rdo las rang byung pa dang*/ de na yam gha la bh+rik+ṣa ces pa ta la'i sdong po gcig rnams 'dugashing de'i rtsa ba nas ma gha la ni'i chu mig lhor 'bab/

de'i shar na shri par pa ta ces pa seng ldeng skyes pa'i ri mi che ba gcig yod/ ri de'i nub sna dang maṅga la na'i chu bzhug 'dzom pa na/ mul pa wik+t+ra zhes pa sa gru gsum gcig 'dug /de na sngon maṅga la dhe wi'i tsan+dan las rang byon gyi sku de bzhugs pa yin zer/ phyis hor dmag gis bsregs pas grong khyer mchog gi shar na bzhugs pa yin skad/ lha khang de na rnal 'byor ma mang po 'dus nas mchod pa rnam pa mang po byed cing 'dug pa la/ ki li dang tsī lī sgra sgrog cing 'dug /der nus pa dang mi ldan pa spa skong zhing skal pa dang ldan la rjes su 'dzin pa yin gsung*/ de rnams kyi zhas na bde mo sham bu can dang*/ sgom ma sle'u thul gon pa 'ga' re 'dug pa rnams la sngon la dam tshig gi rdzas stab cing 'dug /la las/ da nang rdo rje gling nas 'ong bya ba dang*/ la la snga dro der chos nyan du phyin nas sleb pa yin zer nas/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa di ring 'di gsung gi chos kyi tshig khyer 'ong gin 'dug /u rgyan de sprul pa'i gnas gcig rang yod/ de ru bsdad nas zla ba gsum lon tshun chad/ gzhan gyis phud mchod byas pa'ang pha ru sib sib 'ong gin 'dug gsung*/ u rgyan gyi sgo na in+t+ra bo dhis bzhengs pa'i gzhal yas khang 'dug /de mthong na bsgom bya'i skabs kyi dkyil 'khor kun gyi rnam pa gsal po shes pa la phan par 'dug gsung*/ der zhag 'ga' gzims pas/ mkha' 'gro'i ltas dang rol mo'i sgra las theg pas sna tshogs kyi chos kyi sgra ston par 'dug gsung*/ u rgyan gyi nang du tshud nas 'di phan chad zla ba lnga song de nas sngar rjes su 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i zhal nas/ spyir gdams pa 'di lo bcu gnyis su ma bstan/ lo gsum gnyis kyi bar gzhan don ma rtsom/ de nas rtsol med du 'phrin las 'grub/ khyad par drag po'i las 'grub/ lo dgu bcu rtsa drug thub/ rdo reg pa med pa'i 'og tu sgom na dngos grub brgyad cu dang nus pa mnyam par 'gyur gsung*/

de ni rnal 'byor ma dngos kyi sprul pa/ sngar lam du bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ dus phyis kyang rgya bod du bar chad 'byung ba dang*/ gdams pa brjed pa la sogs pa'i dus su gsol ba btab pa'i tshe rje btsun ma dngos su byon pa'ang de'i nus par 'dug gsung*/ slar yang la ba phug tu chu gsol zhing bzhugs par dgongs ste/ hor gyis bsad pa'i mi rus la sogs bsdus nas ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas/ u rgyan ni grong khyer lā+o pa zhes par skyes nas khyim bzung ba dran/ sras gnyis yod pa'i gcig rta nag pa yin par 'dug gsung*/ de dus/ dpal ye na re/ da ni yid ches pas bod du 'deng zer ba la/ sa thag ring po nas lus srog la ma bltas par gnas chen bsnyags/ bsnyag ring yang chog par byung ba yin/ da ni rab thod pa 'di ru 'bor/ de min yang lo gsum tsam sdod pa yin byas pas/ nyid mi gshegs kyang su rig thug skyol/ de min na'ang rā dza hur thug mi skyel ba'i shags yod de zer nas ma nyan pas de bar du skyal/ kha che bar gro ba'i tshong pa la sbrags pas/ skad mi shes pa'i mi 'di khyod med na 'chi ba min pa'i lam med zer/ dgongs pa mdzad pas/ bla ma gcig gis bsdus/ gnas chen la sdongs pa'o grogs su srog gi bar chad du song na bdag gis rigs pa byas par yang mi 'gyur ro snyam du dogs nas/ slar dur khrod gtum drag gi sgo la byas nas/ ra mi shwa ra dang nye ba nas lam byung ste kha cher byon/ paṇ+ḍi ta bhu mi shri la bde mchog la sogs pa zhus/ de nas la gcig la byon pa'i tshe/ sgom ma sle'u zla kham gyon pa mang po'i khrod na/ skra lo can mang rab yod pa 'gro yi snang*/ dris pas u rgyan nas 'ongs/ bod kyi sbud trar khyed kyi 'phrin las kyi grogs la 'gro zer nas mi snang bar gyur/ de tsam na bde sdug gi rkyen thog du ro bsnyams shing bsgoms pas/ rtogs pa mnyam rjes med par 'gyur/ mngon par shes pa thogs med du mnga' bas/

mnga' ris kyi mar yul nub snar phebs pa'i tshe/ bla chen de khyim gyis/ u rgyan 'khor ba'i grub thob gnyis 'dug zer ba thos nas pho brang du gdan drangs pa la/ na bza' ngan pa thung ngu las med pas/ btsun mo jo mo rgyal po'i bsam pa la btsun pa smyon pa 'dra ba 'di kun grub pa thob bam de cang yin nam snyam pa mkhyen nas/ nga ni ma smyo khyo rang smyo byas pas skrag par gyur/ btsad po des dgun grang pa la ras rkyang gcig las med kyang bde drod kyi gzi brjid 'bar ba dang*/ skyems gsol ba byin gyis brlabs pas khol ba dang*/ rgod g.yag ded pa'i rta la rengs pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas mi g.yo bar gyur pa rnams mthong bas/ shin tu dad de nor longs spyod du ma phul yang ma bzhed/ khong rgyal srid spangs nas chos byed zer bas/ nga da rung gdul bya mi skyong bas/ chos rje'i drung du 'gro gsungs pa la/ rgyal po de dgyes ste/ rta pa brgya lhag pa gcig chas pa dang sdongs nas gser kha la phyin pa'i nub gcig thugs nyams la/ chos rje dho li la bteg pa mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor nas byon pa gzigs/ spyan chab phyung zhing gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la// zhen med mos gus kyis gsol ba thob// gdams ngag yid bzhin nor bu la// zhen med yid ches kyis nyams su long*/ rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu la// zhen med ro mnyam du yon tan spel// snying rje yid bzhin nor bu yis// zhen med brlab chen gyi gzhan don mdzod/ gsung nas gshegs/ yang tho rangs nam mkha' la/ sprul pa'i 'gro don mtha' ru phyung*// rdo rje gling du 'phrin las btul// yongs su dag pa'i gang zag la// bshags dang bzhugs pa ga la yod// ces pa sgra grags nas/ nang par jo bo la yar ldog pa 'thad par glengs pas ma nyan/ de nas gzhan las skad thos pas/ jo bo na re/ bla ma 'gro don ran pa'i dus su/ bdag rgyal srid dang bcas pa chos la 'jug

/lo gcig la dge 'dun stong phrag gcig 'tshogs par khas len pas yar gshegs par zhus pas ma dgongs/ chos byed par dmigs pa'i rdzas phul ba yang ma bzhed do// btsad po de yang rang rgyud pa gcig med de/ grib mi tshor/ mar lam chos drug btab pas bde drod kyi nyams bzang po skyes gsung*/ de nas phyis phrad par smon lam mdzad de khong yar blog nas byon/ rta rgod gangs su grogs mched shākya ras pa bya bas bsnyen bkur nas bzhugs/ gnyid 'od gsal gyi ngang nas che chos skye ba 'dzin pa gzigs/ nub cig lbal pa nag po che ba gcig zhal du zhugs/ phyag na rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin mdzad pas 'then sa ma rnyed 'dug /zhabs 'thil du zhugs/ phyag na rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin mdzad pas mthen sa ma rnyed 'dug /zhabs thil du rlung*/ pus mor me gsal btab nas/ de chur bzhu bas zhal nas thon song*/ lus la zhugs phan chad bskyed rim bsgom mi btub par 'dug gsung*/ de nas 'byon par dgongs pa shākya ras pas/ mtsho da ra'i mtsho sman dang*/ rta rgod kyi gzhi bdag la/ u rgyan pa ma btang gcig gsungs pas/ thugs snang bud med gcig gis zhabs la lcags sgrog 'jug du byung*/ 'od gsal gyi ngang nas phyag na rdo rje'i skur langs/ mtsho'i mtha' mo ri'i phreng bas bskor/ nang phyag gis dkrugs pas skams song*/ de na mkhar gcig 'dug par byon pas/ bud med sngon mo g.yu'i thod can gcig 'dug /yang kha char ches grags nas gshegs su ma bcug pa la/ rta rgod kyi gangs mes bskor nas bsregs pas/ rta pa lung pa gang ba byung*/ khyod dang nus pa 'gran no byas pas/ da bzhud zer/ de dus shākya ras pa byung nas/ khyod ci mdzad dam/ da ra mo byung nas nga'i mkhar bshig zer du zer ro// lug lo la rdo rje gling du phebs/ chos skyong gis khrab cing bsus/ chos rje bshags pa'i dus su/ rten ma bzhengs/ gdan sa ma 'dzugs/ ces pa'i bka' brtsal la brten nas/

gra pa thams cad ri la gyes gdung khang gi so phag la tsha tshwa khang pa gcig bzhengs pa la/ sgom ma rgan mo tsho gcig mchod pa 'bul zhing 'dug pas/ der mang du bshums shing gsol ba btab/ na bza' phying pa gcig dang*/ rna lpags kyi zhwa gcig las med pas/ sgom ma rnams kyis ngo ma shes par lug rdzi dad pa can gcig 'dug zer ro// de nub 'od gsal gyi ngang du chos rje dang mjal/ rdo rje gdan du rgyug gsung*/ yang lan gcig byon nas/ 'gro bzang ma 'gro bar 'dug pas 'khor gcig song*/ nang par byon pas/ bu le'i gangs 'gul na 'gro bzang ma yod pa yis/ sgrub pa mo skal bzang dang*/ gsung skyong la sogs yod pa la/ ltos dang u rgyan pa spyan gsum mche ba bzhi/ rus brgyan dang bcas/ mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor nas byung gsung*/ dar gcig na sleb nas mjal bas/ 'gro bzang na re/ slob dpon jo btsun phebs pa thugs la btags/ chos rje mya ngan las 'das kyang*/ khyed bu chen 'gro don nus pa mang po yod pa yin/ khyed rnams kyi sku tshe dang 'phrin las nga'i lag na yod pa lags kyis/ nga yi gshegs par zhu phul mdzod zer/ zhu ba rang mi bgyid do// skyes me rang nam gshegs tsa na gshegs gcig gsungs pas/ snyun med par dbu chogs song*/ ha las nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ skyes mo dam pa mi gshegs par zhu yang yang phul bas spyan hrig byung nas da mchis lus 'phos zin gsung tsam na mdangs legs po de med par song ngo*// de nas rdo rje gling du/ dpal ye/ dpon srin dpe sdong dang gsum 'tshogs nas tshogs gcig mdzad pa'i tshe/ sngar dzā lan dha rar 'o skol gsum 'tshogs nas/ tshogs byed pa/ mi 'ong byas ste byung ba yin gsung*/ chang tshod gcig zhag lngar btsags kyang chang du byung*/ pho nas kyang slum du 'dug pa slar bsdus nas btsags pas kyang byung gsung*/ de nas chos rje'i bka' brgya'i khongs nas nga med gsung nams bar 'brog rdo rje gling*/

sbud tra dga' ldan gling*/ steng 'gro rnams su chos rje'i sku sman dang dar zab rin po che las sgrubs/ tsha tshwa khang la za 'og gi na bza' gsol/ gtsug lag khang ghan 'ji ra btsugs pa bzhengs/ mar me dus mchod btsugs/ ra lu nas gdan sa ba spyan drangs nas bskos te dar bar mdzad/ de nas bar 'brog gla ba 'khar du bzhugs/ dpal bde chen stengs kyi nags khrod du byon nas/ nye gnas shes rin ma/ rdo rje gdan du mi 'gro'i bar 'dir sdod pa yin// khyed la rgyags ci yod/ dka' thub byed kyin yod na nga yang byed pa yin gsung*/ khong gis zhib bre bcu gcig phul/ sngo brngas la 'tsho ba'i thil mdzad/ do ba'i rtsa ba rkor byon pas shing 'dzer gyis snyan ral ba dang*/ phung tshom du byon pas zhabs snyug mas phug pa rnams la 'khrul 'khor mdzad pas sos/ zhal nas/ gtum mo'i gdams pa yin na ngas srog btsongs pa rang mang du byas/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i khyad chos ro snyoms 'di la ngas khrag rnyed pa 'dra ba gcig byas nas nyams su blangs pa yin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal mo ches bshad pa byas pa yin gsung*/ nye gnas kyis/ sku thang la sogs pa dri zhim po'i ngad gda' ba ci lags zhus pas/ byang sems brtan pa'i nus pa yin gsung*/ nang gcig ci rmis gsung*/ ma jo snang 'ur mas mar shags gcig byin pa rmis zhus pas/ mos mar shags/ bshes rdog /zhu lu 'ga' khyer byung gsung tsam na/ cung zad na de bzhin byung nas gdugs tshod drangs/ yang nga la tshe 'di'i 'dun ma sgrub pa'i rtog pa skad gcig kyang mi 'dug /nga'i las thams cad tshar 'dug gsung*/ nga la bsam pa gsum yod/ de gang byas kyang tshe 'di'i lhan 'khris mi 'dug /nub phyogs kyi rgyal po hu la hu can na/ sems can gyi mgo lud phung spungs pa tsam yod/ der phyin na 'gro ba la phan che bar 'dug pa la/ rang gi tshe la gzan pa 'khor mi dag pa gcig 'ong bar 'dug /yang a lam ga par pā ta na/

rgyal bu thams cad sgrol gyis sras pho mo dang btsun mo sbyin par btang ba'i ri 'dra ba gcig la phyin nas/ 'jig rten blos btang gi mgo bton nas slob ma rtogs ldan 'ba' zhig bskyangs nas chos bsam de khos byas zer ba gcig byed/ yang na gzhi mi 'dzin par bod kyi ri dgon rnams su 'phos shing 'gro don byed pa yin te/ dge bshes rnams phrag dog gis 'dzings pa'i sa 'dir chags snyam pa rang mi 'dug 'on kyang chags pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig yod/ gang yin na/ chu bo gaṅga tshun chad la grub thob gling ras rtogs pa mtho bar grags 'dug gsang sngags bla na med pa'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa gcig 'chad na kheng pas nga mi zhan nam snyam/ gzhan du gsang sngags las/ skal pa can tshe gcig gis rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar sgrod par byed pa'i lam zab mo rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen bsgrub gang zag gi rgyud pas bar ma chod pa yod/ lo ts+tshā ba rang yang mi chung ba yin/ rgyud kyi lag len phyin ci ma log pa gcig 'jog pa la brgyud 'dzin bod dag tshe la yang mi bzan pa 'dra ste/ rmi lam du bud med cig gis shing gi dri ma btab nas khyod kyis lo 'di gnyis bar thub zer te de'i dbang du byas na dgu bcu rtsa drug thub pa 'dra gsungs/ yang nyin gcig khyod la rdo rje gdan du 'gro 'dod kyi rtogs pa rags po byung ang gsung*/ byung zhus pas/ nga la de 'dra'i rags po tsam yang med/ 'dun pa rags po byas na 'phral du 'gro dgos par 'dug ste/ chos skyong ma mgon skyas byas nas song*/ 'gro mchod gcig byed pas zan chang gcig gyis gsung*/ de'i dus na nad rims yod pas/ 'gro na tshad pa bas kyang nad rang thu gsung*/ phud dar nas phyin pas/ zhal nas/ mdang dang rmi lam na/ bud med gcig gis rims mang po kho na yang med/ phyugs nad 'dis thub zer ba'i gsung gcig byin/ de gcig pus mi phan byas pas/ mgo mjug du oṃ hūm̐ bcug na thams cad thub zer/

sog po'i yi ge bzhin mas nas klog pa gcig gda' ste/ hā swā re ma ta ṭa ko ma k+ṣa ra sa oṃ/ ces pa 'di 'od gsal gyi ngang nas brtsibs logs la bris pa yin gsung*/ sngags 'di rang lha mo'i yin pa 'dra bar mi gda' 'am zhus pas/ zil chen po byung*/ 'dug 'dug yin par 'dug gsung ḍā dril bsnams/ spyan nam mkha' la gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad/ nye gnas kyis phud mchod pas/ gnyis ka thugs 'ur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mi 'dzugs/ nged rgod phug tsho'i bar chad mi zlog sems can tsho'i nad rims mi gcod pa ci yin gsung zhing*/ sku stod bcer bur bkrabs pas nyi mtshan gyis chu bur thug byung*/ phud rdza ma gang lhag ma ma lus par gtor tshar 'dug khyed kyis lha mau mthong ngam gsung*/ zhal ni ma mthong ste byin brlabs dpag tu med/ snang ba gtad med du song*/ rig pa dngas gda' zhus pas/ ngas mthong*/ bong bu dmar ga 'jigs su rung ba la lcibs pas/ me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin song ba min pa lung par mi shong ba gcig 'dug /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rang yin 'di 'dra'i rig pa dngas pa ltos dang gsung*/ rgyal khams kyi yams 'phral du chad skad/ gzhan yang zhal mang du gzigs gsung yang lan gcig 'obs la sgom btab kyis khyed rang tsho rgyob gsung nas thugs kyi gtad pas rgyab skrogs kyang de ga na bsdad 'dug da zhog dang*/ btang gis gsung nas thugs dam glod pas song skad/ de nas bya lo la rdo rje gdan du byon pas snang ba bden med du song*/ nye gnas kyis de ring byin brlabs che bar gda' zhus pas/ de tsug 'dug chos rje gdan 'degs pa'i snang ba 'dra ba gcig 'dug gsung*/ shod du phebs pa la grib kyis non nas 'byon pa ma byung bas/ phaṭa kyis them la rang gi lus shing sdong pha ki la st-im la cung zad sdod/ da rang rje btsun ma dag pa ye shes sgyu ma'i lus su 'jur thon par bsgoms/ rje 'bri khung grib sel yin/

skyel thung gi bya dga' gyis gsung nas gcig pur bzhud/ bal po'i thang ga me ru sleb pa na/ chos skyong phyag bzhi pa byung nas/ rdo rje gdan pa du ru kas gnod ba byed par yod/ khyod 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa bzhis smon lam btab nas phan pas myur du 'od zer nas khrid pa'i snang ba byung*/ gā+ai ta wa ri legs pa gzigs ye rang du gzhon nu ma 'ga' zung gyis blta zhing sngar mkha' 'gro las thos pa'i glu yod pa 'then cing 'dug /de nas grong khyer ti ra hu tir sleb/ mgon po sngon byung nas lung bstan pa'i ram shing rgyal pos dbang byed cing 'dug pa/ rdo li la bteg /lag na mtshon cha can gyis bskor nas phar khyer zer zhing byung*/ blon po gcig gi dbyug pa blangs nas phar khyer byas nas rgyal po'i thog du 'phyong pas/ ra dzā smyon pa byung zer nas dho li las babs song*/ dbyug pa skyur nas bzhad pas/ dz+yau ki spyod pa byed par 'dug gsung ste khri zur du bzhag nas zas byin gsung*/ mu stegs kyi lha khang du spyod pa mdzad cing phyin/ ma gā ta rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub gyi shing a shād thā/ ghan rdo la'i rgyab na sngo bu chen ba gzigs pas/ mos gus gdung shugs kyis/ dbu dang sku lus so phag gi thang la sdebs shing gsol ba btab/ lus mar mer 'bul snyam yang rkyen gzhan ma rnyed/ bzod med kyi snying rje byang chub kyi sems skyes/ smon lam dpag tu med pa btab bo// de nas byed tshad gzhan don du byas/ sngar dge sbyor yang ma shes par 'dug gsung*/ u rgyan gyi rten maṅga la dhe wi dang*/ chos rje'i zhal mthong ba lta bu dran pas bzung rgyu med pa yang yang byung gsung*/ gar byon du khrom 'ur 'gro ba byung pa la dga' snang gcig 'dug /de nga'i/ rde'u nag po'i lhag rol cig lus par 'dug snyam pa dang chad gsung*/ mchu zla'i nya'i nub mo srin po rnams/ ma hā bo dhi la mchod pa byed du 'ong zhes grags/

de gzigs pa'i slad du bzhugs pas/ srod dus 'od chen po zil chen po dang bcas pa gcig byung*/ srin po 'ong bar 'dug /srin po'i lba pa la btsir bar 'dug snyam te/ gsang bdag gi ting nge 'dzin gsal btab nas rtsig pa la bcar byas 'dug /de ma thag bdag 'dzin ma mthong 'dug dgongs te bzhugs pas/ spre'u chen po mjug la rdebs pa gcig byung*/ za na yang zo snyam tsa na/ de mi dkar po glang po'i gdong can gcig du song*/ zil chen 'dug kyang bdag 'dzin spu tsam yang mi 'dug /'jigs zil de yal ba dang bram ze'i bu tshangs skud can gcig bstan nas/ phyag byas nas/ nga tshogs bdag lags/ bsgrub thabs bde na yod pa long la gtor ma mthong/ 'dzam gling gsum gnyis dbang du bsdus la 'phrin las kyi grogs bya yis zer ro// ma hā bo dhi byang phyogs na/ rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa bltams pa'i sku/ lha'i dbang pos dar dkar gyis blangs pa'i gzugs mthong bas/ 'di ltar srid pa tha ma pa'i sems dpa'i zhabs rtog byar yod pa re dga' snyam nas/ chos rje rgyal ba rgod tshang pa/ steng phyogs su sangs rgyas ma chags pa pad+ma'i spyan zhes par sangs rgya ba'i dus su lha'i dbang por gyur nas zhabs 'bring byed par smon lam btab gsung*/ de nas dz+nyā na ghar+bha logs pa dang lhan cig du ru ka'i dmag zlog pa'i smon lam btab pas zlog ste 'gro rin chog par byung gsung yang dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal na zhing skyong rdo las byon pa gnyis 'dug pa'i mdun du/ khong dang*/ dz+nyā na ghar+bha/ rgya dar tshul gsum gyis bzhugs der bsdad pa rnams phal cher mtsho gcig 'dug pa der lcebs nas shi ba yin zer/ mi rnams nang re zhing khong shi ma shi lta ba la/ nub gcig 'od gsal gyi ngang du mtsho de nas/ mi glang mgo can/ rwa bar na sbrul mgo gsum yod pa gcig 'then nas/ rtsa na phug ron gnyis snang ba'i gcig bros gcig mid pa gcig byung*/

gsang bdag gi skur langs nas brdas pas mtsho nang du song*/ der lcags kyi khyung gcig du sgyur nas mtsho phol rgyangs dang bcas nas bzung bas/ skad grag po dang bcas ste grogs gtong zer nas skyugs/ 'phrin las sgrub par khas blangs so// nang par thugs dam la yod tsam na/ rgya dar tshul khres po khur nas song*/ der dz+nyā na gar+bha can du phyin pas/ byon pa dga'/ mdang zil che nas mtshan gang yar me bteg /yam yom gcig na zer/ byin brlabs gcig mdzad pas bde'o// de nas bod du byon pa'i lam du zhabs cher snyung ba'i skrangs pa gris bshags nas lhog pa bton/ rma bkrus nas 'khrul 'khor mdzad pas sos/ chu chen po gcig rgal ba'i dbus na mar ting ring du song*/ ldog ni ma bden nas bum pa can bzung pas ma bying bar thar/ chu 'gram gyi mi rnams ngo mtshar skyes/ stag gi gnod pa la rengs pa'i sbyor ba mdzad/ bal po thil du bod kyi tshe ring ma la sogs pa bsur byung gsung*/ bde chen stengs su phebs pa'i nub gcig grog po chen po gcig la sku chen po sprul nas zam pa byas nas mi mang po bsgral bas/ chos rje nam mkha' la byon nas/ da ni 'gro don gyi dus la bab pa yin no gsung ba byung*/ yang nub gcig 'od gsal gyi ngang du rdo rje 'chang nas/ rgya gar gyi grub chen rnams/ bod kyi bka' brgyud/ chos rje 'bri khung ba dang*/ rgya ba rgod tshang ba la sogs pa mkha' 'gro tshogs dang lhan cig 'dus nas tshogs 'khor mdzad cing rten 'brel zab mo'i spro ba mdzad cing 'dug rten 'brel gyi ngo bo ma bcos pa yin/ nus pa so so na yod/ phyogs gcig la mtshon na/ rten 'brel gyi ngo bo chu rang du ma bcos pa de yin/ gsher ba chu'i nus pa yin/ chu'i nus pa de chu la logs na med/ de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang bcos su ma btub ste/ ma bcos pa rang gi steng na nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig yod/

rten 'brel gyi nus pa yon tan du 'gyur ba de bka' brgyud rnams kyi mkhyen nas bsgrigs pa yin gsung ba byung gsung*/ ge lung du byon pa'i mchod gral du/ de ring rnal 'byor pho mo 'di rnams la phyag rgya chen po gcig gdab po gsung nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor mdzad pas thams cad 'ur/ la la dran med du song*/ de'i mjug tu srog g.yo med du bcing ba'i ting nge 'dzin mdzad pas/ thams cad rtog pa thim pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'gro ba byung*/ bla ma mdo sde'i zhal nas byin brlabs kyi snang ba rang che/ sngon shed kyi grub thob kyis 'di 'dra byung ba'i lo rgyus 'dra thos pa las dngos su ma mthong gsung*/ de tsam na snod ldan gzigs shing rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen bsgrub myong khrid du mdzad pas/ 'ga' zhig la sa rlung zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang gis kyang mi g.yo ba dang*/ kha zas la sogs mi dran par gzhan gyis sad dgos pa byung bas/ la la chu rlung zin pas g.yang la lhung yang mi gnod pa dang*/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pas mi snang ba dang rtsig pa dang ri la mi thogs pa byung bas/ 'di'i khrid btab na lung pa grub thob kyis 'gang bar 'dug ste/ rang gi khams la yang gzan pa dang*/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i zab lam mos gus kyi khrid srol 'di la yang gnod par 'dug gsung nas/ khrid kyi srog lhan cig skyes sbyor la sogs la mthil du mdzad par gda'o// yang bde chen stengs su rdo rje dbyangs can ma dmar mo bsnyen pas/ zhag gsum na pi waṃ gi sgra thos/ 'dzin blo 'phel par byung*/ nyin gcig phu na yar bseng du byon pa'i sar ri sgog gsol bas rjed nges par song*/ khyod 'dra'i yi dam sgog pas blo 'grib pa dgongs nas/ phag mo shes rab snang ba bsgrubs pas/ tho rangs gcig nam mkha' la ka sogs yi ge rnams dkar gyis bris pa ltar 'dug pa rnams ka nas rim bzhin zhal du zhugs/ sngon dpon lam chung bdud rtsi'i khar yig ge'i phreng ba zhugs pas a la brdugs zer dgongs pa byung ste ma rdugs/

sad tsa na gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i spun thag chad pa'i ngang nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma mtshon gang ba gcig gzigs ste don gyi blo gros mchog tu 'phel lo// sbud trar skye bo sum stong tsam la sems bskyed mdzad pa'i tshe nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi bla rer chags pa byung*/ de dus 'od bskor gyi nang du 'phags pa zhal bcu cig pa gzigs gsung*/ de nas bla chen de khyim gyis spyan drangs/ hor dmag gi rkyen gyis zhig pa'i btsun pa khrims 'chal lnga brgya phyir bcos byas/ nyin gcig la btsun rgyu phyed dang gnyis brgya/ gser srang*/ gos dar/ rta brgya tshan re res thog drangs longs spyod dpag tu med pa phul nas chos zhus/ de tsam na rdo rje gdan gyi lcags ri sog pos bshig zer bas/ dz+nyā na ghar+bha la longs spyod du ma bskur nas gsor btang te byang ngos gsos so// phyogs gzhan/ ya tse dang*/ zangs gling rgyal pos gsos skad/ dus de nas nga la sangs rgyas dang*/ rje rgod tshang pa las bsam rgyu med gsung nas phyag rdzas phal cher der bskur ba yin no// sbud trar/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī rin tra la sogs lnga bcu la dus kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga mdzad/ bum chu sgra bcas su khol/ khro bo phebs pa grub thob chen po dus kyi 'khor lor gyur pa mthong ba rnams byung*/ de dus 'dang zhag u rgyan sprul pa'i lho phyogs shin tu gsal lo tshig kyang thal/ shar phyogs nas bsnyen bsgrub kyi gdams pa len pa gcig 'ong gsung tsam na/ gdan sa g.ya' bzangs kyi rin po che 'khar chu ba byon/ dmigs pa re la gser zho re'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas myong khrid du zhus so// de nas gcen po'i nang rten sgrub tu kyi rong du byon/ bal po ljong gi shar 'gal so ri khrod du 'byung po 'dul byed bsnyen pas mngon sum du gzigs nas thun mong gi dngos grub gnang*/ bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma byon nas/

rigs kyi bu da ni rdo rje gsum bsnyen bsgrub yig ger bri ba ngas gnang ngo gsung nas mi snang bar song*/ de nas skos dkar dben gnas su glegs bam du bkod do// gzhan yang dus tha dad du gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud sogs kyi 'gyur 'ga' re yang mdzad do// de nas sbud tra rtsig pa'i tshe/ se chen rgyal pos bal yul 'joms par 'dod pa'i gser yig pa byung ba la/ chu bo rabs dang rgyal po rab kyi phreng ba gnyis mdzad pa skur nas mi 'thad par gsol bas chog /yang nga'i 'gro sa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul yin gsung nas bod bdun bcu tsam cig khrid nas byon/ khral sa ma nyan pa khrag du skyugs pa dang*/ chom rkun la rengs pa'i sbyor ba mdzad/ bal rgya mtshams kyi la ma hā par pa ta la bro brdung mdzad pas nyams 'ur nas ngal dub sangs ti ra hu ti nas/ glang bu mi skad go ba gcig nyos nas chibs pa mdzad/ gaṅga'i rtsa nas lha tshogs kyi bdag po rta dkar po'i gzugs su sprul pas bsus/ ma hā bo dhi'i gnas su bde bar phyin/ sku gdung la rin po che'i snod la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag du ma dang*/ shing drung pa rnams la kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bsnyen bkur/ rnal 'byor pa rnams la dam tshig gi rdzas kyis mchod pa yon dang bcas pa bsgrubs/ de'i dus su/ dz+yau ki pa rnams kyis tshogs rdzas la brten nas bgegs bzhugs pa'i bar chad byung 'dug pa sol bar zhus pa la bka' bsgo mdzad pas sel/ de nas rgyal bu thams cad sgrol gyis bzhugs pa'i ri la/ lam gha par pa ta gzigs/ thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams der bzhugs/ dpon slob gzhan rnams bod du byon/ skyi rong gi grong 'dab kyi nags gcig na thugs dam mdzad cing bzhugs pa bze mo gcig gis mthong nas gcig gis gcig sbran pa drug cu tsam gyis chang bshug ma re khyer byung nas drangs pa gsol ba'i sar/ bho ṭa paṇ+ḍi ta byon nas/ u rgyan pa 'di/

yon bdag mo 'di tsam bsdus nas chang 'thung 'di 'dra byed pa zer/ yon bdag mo rang tsho 'thung gin gda' yis/ ngas ni ma 'thungs gsung*/ khyod kyis 'thungs ma 'thungs ngas shes zer ba la/ 'o na snoms gsungs pas/ zhal la bsnams nas skyur dri mi 'dug zer/ khyod kyis chang 'thungs 'dug skyur dri gda' gsungs pas/ ngas zil pa tsam yang lce la ma bzhag pa la skyur dri rang ngo shes zer/ der khong gi lte bar chang khol bzhin pa skyed pas skyur sgreg chil byung*/ gzhan snom du bcug pas skyur dri chen po 'dug zer/ khong skyengs nas grub thob du 'dug /bya ru mi btub par gda' zer skad/ skyi rong bde legs stengs su 'od gsal gyi ngang du bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gzigs/ lha mo u ma'i dod por tsan+t+ri ka logs na 'dug pa la/ mgo bo phul zer bas bcad nas phul ba la ched 'dzin med pa'i ngang nas/ yang lan gcig gdan sa bas ngo mtshar bstan pa'i slad du gza' mi 'dza' mo gnyis yod pa la dbye ba'i sbyor ba gcig ston dang gsungs pas/ rlung sbyor cig mdzad nas ltos gsung*/ bltas pas skra 'byid res byas gda'/ zhal nas dang po nga'i lus kyi rtsa mdud mang po zhig song*/ phyi rol du'ang sa gzhi g.yo ba dang khang pa 'jig pa 'ong gsung*/ de tsam na dpon chen kun dga' bzang pos sbud tra'i gzim khang bshig pas nyin mo sa bsros pa la sogs byung skad de/ lo lnga na rjes med du brlag go /nub gcig gzim chung na thugs dam mdzad pa'i drung du/ jo bo ston tsan byung nas dbang zhu zer/ nye gnas la bum pa chos gsung*/ cho ga rim par mdzad nas/ bum dbang gi skabs su bum pa thog gsung*/ bteg pas da mthong gsung*/ ma nus pas the tshom mi dgos gsung*/ btang bas nam mkha' la 'dug go /sa skyar bla ma chos rgyal phebs zhes nas mjal du byon/ mdo sde/ mang du gsan de nas nyang ror byon pa'i chu mig ring mor khrom la dgug pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pas khri phrag re tsam gar gshegs su 'brang ba byung*/

shangs su dgon pa tsha ri zlum po btab ste 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad/ yang sbud trar byon/ mchod pa gcig gi tshe shar phyogs su gzigs nas gtam cig 'dug gsung*/ zhus pas/ shar 'di na gur mgon gyi lkog ma'i 'og na 'o skol gyi khang pa tshud pa tsam cig 'dug /dpon chen byang rin gyi sar byin brlabs la byon 'phrin las kyi grogs bgyid zer gsung*/ zhag 'ga' na gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa byung nas rta lo'i ston ser kha bteg nas/ 'jad kyi 'od mo dar sdings su byon nas khong gi don mdzad/ de nas sha za mda'i rta mig ma'i nags gnyan po gcig 'dug par bzhugs/ slob dpon rigs ral gdan drangs nas tshad ma sde bdun la sogs pa'i lung zhus/ yar lha sham pos spyan drangs nas sil ma la bzhin dbus su byon pa la byon pas/ stag gru khar sleb pa'i tshe/ mi phan par 'dug /da res karma pa can khor gcig 'gro dgos par 'dug gsung nas snye mo bzhin byon/ kun dga' ra bar phebs/ slob dpon bo ran rgyud don yod la phur pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bka' zhus/ dus phyis sbrang nyi khri sbud trar spyan drangs nas ma mo'i bka' zhus/ de nas karma pa mtshan mo bzhengs nas byon te/ kha 'khyags tshe longs/ nyi ma la stod nas u rgyan pa chen po gnam gyi sa bkab pa 'dra ba 'byon yin yod gsung nas/ bu ram bsgor/ zan rdzis skad/ zhal nas/ karma pa'i slob ma tsho brel 'dug /cag ya gyis gsung nas u ri mdun du bzhugs/ phebs pa'i gdong du ja 'dzin dang*/ ser sbrengs dang rol chas bsus/ mjal ba'i tshe/ karma pa'i zhal nas/ khyed zhag gsum gyi gong du phebs rgyu yin pa la da bar ma byon/ zan rnams rul gsung*/ nged 'brug pa zlog sgom byed pa yin gsung pas bzhad cing*/ khyed zlog bsgom byed na skyag pa khar chug /bu ram rkub du chug gsung*/ ye grub thob u rgyan pa khyod nga'i rtsar mi 'byon par sil ma la la 'gro 'dod par snang ste/

nga'i byang chub sems dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gros rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus pa yin e go gsung yang chos skyong la gtor tshogs chen po thong*/ dung thong la u rgyan pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu byon yod/ mtshur phu gdan sa na yod pa thams cad dga' ba bsgoms/ 'bul ba khyer la chos zhus kyis gsung*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang byed gsung nas/ ka to ra nas kyi bkang ba sba lcag gis bskrugs pa dbu thog tu bzhag /lcag dang bcas pa phyag du gtad/ dbu'i zhwa nag de skon/ sku gsum ngo sprod gnang hur mdzad nas/ 'o skol gnyis skye ba du ma'i dpon slob yin/ nga yi mgo 'don yang khyod kyis byed dgos/ khyod kyi gdul bya nyi ma lho rgyud na yod/ der nga'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ snying po yig ge drug ma dang*/ sku gsum ngo sprod kyis 'gro don mdzod/ dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po grub thob u rgyan pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs gcig ces pa yang yang gsung*/ de nas lha sa/ bsam yas/ gdan sa/ g.ya' bzangs nas dmyal dang mtsho sna'i bar du byon/ snye 'dor zhi byed rgyud pa phyi ma'i skor gsan/ dbus kyi dge ba'i gshen gnyen dang skye bo mchog dman dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ dus der lha btsun ye shes 'od kyis/ rje rin po che'i rnam thar khrigs kha rtsa ba nas bud ba 'di dang po rang nas thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa lags sam/ rje rgod tshang pa dang mjal nas byung ba lags zhus pas/ smyon pa'i spyod pa 'di dang po nas yod pa min/ bu tsha'i dus su 'dri klog dang pha chos kyi rigs rnying ma slob pa'i dus dang*/ bo dong du mtshan nyid slob pa rtsangs so ru dus 'khor nyan pa'i dus thams cad du/ shes rab dang brtul zhugs che shos yin/ brtson 'grus dang khrigs kha/ go cha dang sdug sran/ pho rus dang sbad kham/ she mong dang pho ngar che shos yin/ de'i dus na 'dun ma'i khrigs kha nga las mkhas pa yod/ de nas chos rje'i drung du sleb pa'i dus su/

bla ma dang thugs yid 'dres nas/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi don rtogs/ ma bcings ma grol ba'i ngang du gzugs 'dzin gyi mdud pa zhig nas/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs/ gnyid kyi ngang du bde ba chen por shar/ 'pho 'gyur dang skye shi med/ rtsol sgrub dang 'gro 'ong med/ gzugs 'dzin dang rtag chad med/ mtha' dbus dang phyi nang med/ spangs rtogs dang mtho dman med/ bcings grol dang spros pa med/ dngos po dang mtshan ma med pa'i don rtogs/ ma bsdams ma glod par rang sor bzhag pas mdud pa ma bshig par rang sar grol/ rang dag rang grol/ grol mkhan med par grol ba sbrul mdud bzhin du zhig nas/ bcings pa dang grol ba dus mnyam/ ma bsgrims ma gsal bar mngon sum rnam par dag kun nas rnam par byang ba med pa/ mthar phyin rgyu dang phyin mkhan med pa/ mya ngan las 'da' ba dang 'da' mkhan med pa/ mig gi nad grol bas skra shad sangs pa lta bu'i rtogs pa shar bas/ khrigs chags kyi 'dun ma thams cad rang sar zhig nas/ rtsis med smyon pa'i spyod pa 'di 'dra cig byung gda' de'i steng du u rgyan sprul pa'i zhing du phyin pa'i dus su/ bcom ldan ma nyid kyi byin brlabs kyis/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas/ mi rgya/ sangs rgya bar mi 'gyur/ rgyas pa dang mi 'gal ba'i don rtogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kun nas nyon mongs pa ma spangs/ mi spong*/ spaung bar mi 'gyur/ spangs pa dang mi 'gal/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rnam par bya ba mngon du ma byas/ mi byed byed par mi 'gyur/ byas pa dang mi 'gal/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chos tshig gcig kyang ma gsungs/ mi gsung*/ gsung bar mi 'gyur/ gsungs pa dang mi 'gal ba'i don rtogs/ de yan chad sngar bas khrigs chung du song nas/ gshis kyi gtad so dang bral bas ci byed cha med pa/ tshig gi go rim dang bral bas smyon pa lta bu/

'phral phugs kyi khrigs kha med pas sprang po lta bu/ tshig la ngos bzung med pas ston chung gi bzhad gad lta bu/ sgra skyon ngos mi 'dzin/ don skyon blo la mi 'jog /gong 'og gi 'gal 'brel mi rtsi/ rtsom pa rang yang khar phog snar phog de 'dra tsho byed pa gcig byung gda' gsung*/ yang khrid kyi 'debs lugs la nges med du mdzad pa gcig gda' ba ji ltar lags zhus pas/ khrid kyi 'debs lugs 'di la nges pa chen po med/ res bla ma'i thugs kyi rtsal/ res dus kyi gnad/ res 'ga' slob ma'i rgyud tshod/ res 'ga' yul rkyen gyi stabs la brten nas/ 'debs lugs ci rigs su dgos pa yin/ de la gang dang gang gi rgyud tshod dang 'thun pa/ dus kyi gnad la phebs pa'i gdams pa 'debs shes pa gal che gsung*/ yar lam snye me lca ba lung du mchod pa gcig gi tshe zil chen po byung tsam na/ rin po che karma pa nam mkha' la byon pa gzigs/ bstod pa mdzad/ de rjes rgyal po se chen gan gyi dad pa'i shugs kyis mi chen e ji lag go rin/ thog the mur rnams rim par mngags kyang ma byon pa la/ dus phyis mi chen ne gu ta/ lan bzhi par 'ongs pa'i tshe/ sngon rdo rje gdan du mi dkar po gcig gis/ hor gyi rgyal pos gdan 'dren par 'gyur gyis/ de ni bsod nams tshad med pa dang ldan pa yin pas de'i ngag ma bcag cig ces pa byung*/ de spyan ras gzigs su 'dug gsung nas/ chu pho 'brug gi lo/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum la rgya yul du byon/ shing kun du sleb pa la na bza' brje ba la sogs pa rnams byas pa'i tshe/ 'khor rnams la longs spyod pa 'dun pa cung zad kyang mi btub/ byas na 'dod pa'i mda' dug khong du zhen nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde legs thams cad kyi bdag dang bral ba yin gsung*/ pho brang du phebs ma thag rgyal po'i phyag zhabs 'khums pa la dbyug pa'i spyad kyis cung zad bde bar mdzad/

de rjes mi chen rnams la/ spyir mi'i lus la lte ba'i dus sbyor gyi rtsa la rlung 'pho chen bcu gnyis rgyu ba las/ gong ma'i sku la 'pho ba gsum las med/ dus sbyor gyi rtsa 'dab dgu skams pa yin/ ro bcud kyi gdam ngag kyang 'chis 'dug nga yang spyod pa brtsing*/ sa skya pa 'di pa byed pa ngan/ 'dir sdod pa sdig zas sdig chu kho na la longs spyod dgos pa 'di blo la mi ran pas/ nga yar 'gro ba'i zhu ba byed pa yin/ khyed rnams kyis kyang rogs gyis gsung nas gong mas bla ma chos rgyal gyi shel dam 'bul pa la sogs ci zhus kyang ma gnang*/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang mdzad/ rin po che dang dar zab sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i gong mas shing rta kha sag gsum/ rgyal bu gnyis kyis re re phul/ thams cad 'u lag gis mi 'byongs/ 'di 'dra phul ba'i dpe med ces lkog tu gleng*/ zhal nas/ nga la nor gyis dgos pa med/ nor 'dod nas 'ongs pa min gsung na ma bzhed/ gong mas rnal 'byor pa grub pa brnyes pa la mi dgos kyang*/ khyed kyi 'khor ban de 'di rnams thag ring nas/ khyed rang dang nga la bsams nas yongs pa yin/ 'di rnams la byin pas chog zhus pas/ nga'i 'khor 'di rnams bya btang 'ba' zhig yin/ chos byed na 'tsho ba nga yis 'byongs/ lar 'dod na/ rgyud sde rin po che'i gdams pas gser 'gyur dang dngul du byed pa'i lag len shes/ de'i phyir yang khyod kyi longs spyod la ltos mi dgos gsung*/ de lta bu gcig ston dang zhus pas/ gsha' brtse dngul du bsgyur nas phul bas/ ngo mtshar bar 'dug /nga'i mdzod chud 'dza' bas ma ston gsung de ltar pho brang du zla ba phyed gnyis las ma bzhugs par/ lung dang longs spyod phul ba ma bzhed de byon pa'i dus su/ gong ma ma mnyes te/ u rgyan pag shi khyed ngas sa thag ring mo nas gdan drangs nas bzhugs zhus bas mi nyan par 'phral du 'gro /nga la dbang bskur mi byed par gzhan la byed/

nga'i nor mi len par gzhan gyi len zer ba la/ ngas chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgod tshang pa chen po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la btugs nas da lta'i bar du sna thag gzhan la gtod ma myong*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la slob dpon gyis slob ma dam tshig la sgor ba las/ slob mas slob dpon dam tshig la sgor ba yang med/ brgya byin mdun du byung yang mgo bo bkas nas klad pa 'dag snyam pa las 'jigs snyam pa med pa gsungs pas/ gong ma mchi ma phral byung*/ mi chen no ga skyel du btang*/ yar lam rtse lnga bskor te byon no// rjes su gong mas bla mchod rnams bsogs nas/ khyed rnams na re/ u rgyan pas chos mi shes zer ba la/ khyod kyis shes pa thams cad ni khos shes par 'dug khos shes pa mang po khyes mi shes par 'dug /de chos mi shes pa yin nam zer/ khos khrigs su byas pa'i chos spyod mang po g.yeng ba gang gis kyang mi 'phrog par gzhan gyis mi 'grub pa 'grub par 'dug /de bsnyen pa yin nam/ zog po yin zer te zog longs spyod kyi phyir byed pa yin/ kho nor rdzas gang la yang 'dod pa mi 'dug de zog po yin nam gsung pa la pag shi rnams smra ba med do// yang mi chen rnams la/ pag shi bzang po gcig khugs pa yin te/ khyed rnams kyis bsten pa ma byung gsung*/ pus mo btsugs nas gong ma rang gis lung shor bas nged rnams kyis thabs med zhus pas/ ngas lung shor yang kha zas la brtsi ba gcig 'dug pa khyed kyis zas sna tshogs byin na legs pa yin te zhes thugs chad kyang gsung skad/ ngas byang chub kyi sems tshad med pas kun nas blangs nas/ sems can mang po la las 'brel bzhag /'u lag gzhon pa rnams kyang ngan song las thar ba yin gsung*/ de ltar skyes mchog dam pa 'dis snga phyir paṇ+ḍi ta rawishri bha tra dang*/ pra ba ka raḥchag lo ts+tsha ba la sogs pa rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma bsten cing*/ rig pa'i gnas/ gzhung*/

gdams pa mang du gsan/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud la sogs pa'i 'gyur dang*/ dus 'khor sogs kyi bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ bcom ldan 'das bde mchog 'khor lo la sogs pa'i yi dam gyi lha du ma gzigs/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi gzugs su snang ba la sogs sprul sgyur la dbang thob/ thugs dam mnyam rjes mi mnga' yang*/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi snga drau phyi drau'i thun la bde mchog gi phyi rol mchod pa/ thun mtshams su thugs bskyed len pa/ thugs dam gtor ma cha bcu bdun/ thun mong gi bcu/ 'dzam lha rigs gsum sogs chu sbyin/ gung la bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gdung la phyag mchod skor ba/ phyi drau zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rnams mi 'chag par mdzad/ dus phyis kyi bar du'ang*/ thos pa btsal bas mi ngoms shing*/ yon tan cung zad dang ldan na bla ma'i gnas su ma longs pa la'ang*/ gus pas btud nas len pa dang*/ gsung rab du ma gzigs pa dang*/ 'brir 'jug pa dang*/ gzhan la rgyud 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa mang du bsgrubs nas byin te bshad par bskul ba dang*/ bdog pa'i dngos po rnams bla ma dang rdo rje gdan gyis thog drangs pa'i zhabs rtog dang sbyin gtong mdzad de/ yongs su 'dzin pa mi mnga' ba dang*/ gang zag mchog dman du ma'i blo dang*/ skad rigs sna tshogs dang mtsham par ston pas so sor tshim par mdzad pa dang*/ nad dang gdon gyis gtses pa rnams byin brlabs dang rten 'brel gyis zh-i bar mdzad pa dang*/ bar do'i sems can gzigs shing gnas par bar mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang lkog du gyur pa mthong pa dang*/ thugs gtad tsam gyis bya la sogs pa'ang ting nge 'dzin du 'gro ba dang*/ rang rgyud kyi chags pa dag /lba ba sbubs su nub/ bde drod kyi ye shes brgyas/ ras rkyang re gsol/ kun rtags kyi ngo tsha las grol/ spyod lam lhug par mdzad/ 'du ba ro snyoms/ phyi nang gi zag pa dngas/ gzhan gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen/

'phrin las bzhi dang las chen bcu gnyis la dbang 'byor pas rgya gar rgya nag kha che bal po/ u rgyan dzā lan dha ra/ bod mi nyag rnams kyi rgyal 'bangs skye bo'i tshogs phal pa dang paṇ+ḍi ta dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par ba du ma smin cing grol bar mdzad de/ ngas phyaugs gcig du bskyangs na tshogs pa dang longs spyod rje 'bri khung ba dang mnyam pa yin gsung*/ de nas dgung lo bdun bcu spre'u'i lo nas bzhugs pa'i gsung mang du byon te/ dbang khrid gdams pa rgya cher bstan nas/ ngas sngon khrid btab pa rnams la nyams tshan che ba gcig skye yin 'dug /dus phyis rtogs pa ngo 'phrod pa shas che bar 'dug gsung*/ de rjes dgung lo brgyad cu zhes pa la sku la snyun mi mnga' yang*/ sku shed cung chung bar gyur nas gdul bya rnams la zhal ta dang*/ byin brlabs kyi phyi ma mdzad de/ bya'i lo khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu'i tshe sprul pa'i sku gang nas byon pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru bsdu bar mdzad/ 'brug dang*/ glaug dang*/ char dang*/ mja'i 'od 'khrug pa'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ mar gyi tshes bcu la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sku la zhugs phul bas sku gdung dang ring ba srel gyi snang ba 'phro bas rjes 'jug tshim par mdzad do// yongs su grub pa'o/// /bdag nyid chen po dngos grub brnyes pa'i gnas las mtshan du gsol ba u rgyan pa yongs su grangs pa'i sras sprul pa'i sku rang byung rdo rje/ g.ya' bzangs pa rin po che mkhar chu ba/ snye mdo ba kun mkhyen kun dga' don grub/ glang khor gyi 'jam dbyangs bsod nams 'od zer/ bzhi'o/ de dang nye ba brgyad ni/ a pa lung pa 'jam dbyangs rdo rje/ 'bri khung gi bla ma chos blo/ mus pa sku zhang pa/ bla ma lhar rje pag shi/ me shel ba/ mkha' 'gro phug pa/ bla ma gdan sa ba/ mchog tu gyur pa bzhi ni/ grub thob snye mo ga pa/

tsha chung ba/ g.yag mgo ba/ skyes mchog dam pa ri khrod pa'o// rnal 'byor pa sno dar ba'i slob pa ni/ rgya gar gyi mu stegs byed a ya dbang phyug pa sba ras/ rtogs ldan a ri dgas/ rtsibs ri zur phug pa/ rtogs ldan zla ba seng ge /mtha' bzhi dpon ras/ shan ti ras pa/ dbu ma pa/ bla ma ra tse/ rgya ri ba/ rin rdor ba la sogs pa mang po dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi slob ma mkhan chen sher pa/ la zhing ba/ nyi ma lung pa/ rmog cog pa/ songs dkar ba/ dge sdings pa/ phug chung ba/ chag lo'i dbon po bstan 'dzin dpal/ lha btsun ye shes 'od/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ shong lo tsa ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sgra tshad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rnam grol ba la sogs pa mang du bzhugs so// rgyal ba rnams kyis dam pa'i chos 'dzin par gyur cig// /
